ratios.quote: Minimum consolidated fixed charge coverage ratio 1.25 6.25

parsed.notes: Under the November 5, 2025 First Amendment, up to $100 million of unrestricted cash may be netted against consolidated funded indebtedness, so the leverage covenant is effectively a net leverage measure. The First Amendment raised the maximum leverage limit from 3.50 to 3.75. The limit steps up to 4.25 (previously 4.00) for the four consecutive quarters following an acquisition with aggregate consideration of $50.0 million or more. Leverage-based pricing margins are excluded.
